# Absolute Veritas

> Absolute Veritas is a TIC (Testing, Inspection, Certification) and IT compliance provider offering product certification, regulatory consulting, and quality assurance services across India and 12 Asian countries.

With 15+ years of industry expertise, Absolute Veritas specializes in helping manufacturers navigate Indian regulatory standards including BIS, CDSCO, and telecom certifications. The company serves domestic and foreign manufacturers seeking compliance with Indian government standards and quality requirements.

## Key Topics

- BIS Certification
- CDSCO Medical Device Registration
- ISI Mark
- India Compliance
- Product Certification
- Regulatory Standards
- Quality Assurance
- Manufacturing Standards
- TEC Certification
- WPC Certification
- BEE Energy Efficiency
- Conformity Assessment
- Testing & Inspection
- Bureau of Indian Standards
- Certification Services

## BIS Certification Services

- [BIS Registration for Electronics & IT Products, Consultants, BIS CRS Certification | Absolute Veritas](https://absoluteveritas.com/bis-crs-certification): BIS CRS certification guide for electronics and IT products with expert consultants
- [ISI Mark Certification | BIS Certification ISI Mark Consultants | Absolute Veritas](https://absoluteveritas.com/isi-mark-certification): ISI Mark certification procedure and support for Indian manufacturers
- [Foreign Manufacturer Certification Service India | BIS Certification for Foreign Manufacturers | Foreign Manufacturer Registration India](https://absoluteveritas.com/foreign-manufacturer-certification-services): BIS FMCS registration and certification service for foreign manufacturers in India
- [Hallmark Certificate Service in Delhi | Hallmark License Service | Absolute Veritas](https://absoluteveritas.com/hallmark-certification): BIS hallmark certification for gold and silver jewelry purity and authenticity
- [BIS Certification for Toys | Procedure | Documents - Absolute Veritas](https://absoluteveritas.com/bis-license-for-toys): BIS toy safety certification procedure and quality control compliance guide
- [BIS Certificate Of Conformity Under Scheme IV](https://absoluteveritas.com/bis-certificate-of-conformity-under-scheme-iv): BIS Certificate of Conformity requirements under Scheme IV conformity assessment
- [Scheme X BIS Certification | Expert BIS Scheme X Consultant in India](https://absoluteveritas.com/bis-scheme-x): BIS Scheme X certification guidance for switchgear and electrical equipment

## Telecom & Electronics Certification

- [TEC Certification | Trusted TEC Approval Consultants in India](https://absoluteveritas.com/tec-certification): TEC telecom equipment certification and DOT compliance support for manufacturers
- [WPC Certification India | Trusted WPC Certification Consultant](https://absoluteveritas.com/wpc-certification): WPC wireless and RF device certification for India telecom compliance
- [Bee Certification | Absolute Veritas](https://absoluteveritas.com/bee-certification): BEE energy efficiency certification and star rating compliance guidance

## Medical Device & CDSCO Registration

- [CDSCO Medical Device Registration | CDSCO Approval Consultants in India](https://absoluteveritas.com/cdsco): CDSCO medical device and cosmetics registration and approval guidance
- [CDSCO Import License for Medical Devices in India | Absolute Veritas](https://absoluteveritas.com/cdsco-import-license-for-medical-devices-in-india): CDSCO import license process and medical device registration requirements
- [CDSCO Medical Device Manufacturing License in India](https://absoluteveritas.com/cdsco-medical-device-manufacturing-license-in-india-): CDSCO medical device manufacturing license and MDR 2017 compliance process

## Industrial Safety & Compliance

- [PESO Certification services | Absolute Veritas](https://absoluteveritas.com/peso-certification): PESO explosives and pressure vessel safety certification for oil and gas sector
